load_urdf_objects: load URDF robot models like kuka_iiwa and pr2_gripper into a pybullet simulation environment
create_joint_constraints: create fixed and gear joint constraints between robot links and grippers in pybullet
reset_joint_states: reset joint states and apply position control to robot joints using setJointMotorControl2
configure_simulation: configure pybullet simulation gravity, rendering, and real-time simulation settings
load_sdf_gripper: load SDF gripper models and attach them to robot end effectors via constraints
